subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors. 1  5 =
stimulus: A paragraph and an essay are different from each other. (a) ⎯⎯ there are some similarities between them. (b) ⎯⎯ a paragraph has a topic sentence to introduce the main idea. Second, it has a number of sentences in the middle to develop the main ideas as well as some connectors to connect those ideas. (c) ⎯⎯ there is a concluding sentence in it to bring the main idea to a close. (d) ⎯⎯ the essay also consists of a beginning, a middle and an end. It is, (e) ⎯⎯, obvious that the paragraph and the essay share some common features in respect of the structures. But the main difference lies in the fact that a paragraph must be completed within a paragraph, while an essay may consist of many paragraphs.
guide_solution: Use of sentence connectors (a) But (b) First/ Firstly (c) Third/Thirdly (d) Similarly (e) in fact
